facts.text: The hotel is on Hong Kong Island, facing Victoria Harbour.
facts.excerpt: Situated on Hong Kong Island facing the world-famous Victoria Harbour

facts.text: The hotel is a 5-minute walk from Exit B3 of Exhibition Centre station on the East Rail Line.
facts.excerpt: Grand Hyatt Hong Kong is a 5-minute walk from the Exit B3 of the Exhibition Centre station (East Rail Line).

facts.text: Many of the rooms and suites have views of Victoria Harbour.
facts.excerpt: with many commanding stunning views of Victoria Harbour

facts.text: Guestrooms and suites are designed to blend traditional and modern aesthetics in an elegant, residential style.
facts.excerpt: guestrooms or suites, designed to blend traditional and modern aesthetics in an elegant, residential style

facts.text: Plateau rooms sit within the spa facility, with access to fitness studios, a garden and other recreation areas.
facts.excerpt: Escape to privacy and seclusion in a 38-square-metre room within the spa facility, offering treatments in Plateau Spa and access to fitness studios, garden and other recreation areas.

facts.text: The Victoria Harbour Suite has 270-degree views of the Hong Kong skyline.
facts.excerpt: Take in the 270-degree views the Hong Kong skyline with the Victoria Harbour Suite

facts.text: The Grand Suite has a 180-degree view of Victoria Harbour and the Hong Kong skyline.
facts.excerpt: Set your sights on a 180-degree view of the Victoria Harbour and the Hong Kong skyline in this spacious 65-square metre suite.

facts.text: Grand Club is a lounge exclusively for suite and club floor guests.
facts.excerpt: Grand Club provides a luxurious lounge exclusively for suite and club floor guests.

facts.text: Grand Club serves all-day Champagne and evening cocktails with a panorama of Victoria Harbour through floor-to-ceiling windows.
facts.excerpt: all-day Champagne and evening cocktails—all under the dramatic panorama of Victoria Harbour through floor-to-ceiling windows

facts.text: The heated outdoor swimming pool on the 11th floor has views of the Central skyline.
facts.excerpt: Located on the 11th floor of our hotel, the 50-metre heated swimming pool commands spectacular views of the Central skyline.

facts.text: Plateau Spa on the 11th floor is a self-contained resort within the hotel, offering privacy and seclusion from the city.
facts.excerpt: Located on the 11th floor of Grand Hyatt Hong Kong, the Plateau Spa is a self-contained resort within our hotel, offering privacy, seclusion and an escape from the vibrant city.

facts.text: Plateau Spa treatments take place in private treatment rooms with en suite bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: treatments conducted in private treatment rooms with en suite bathrooms

facts.text: Waterfall Bar on the 11th floor is an all-day alfresco poolside lounge.
facts.excerpt: Located on the 11th floor tucked away from the hustle and bustle of the city, Waterfall Bar is an all-day alfresco poolside lounge

facts.text: The Fitness Centre offers complimentary active wear rental for guests.
facts.excerpt: including complimentary active wear rental services for guests

facts.text: One Harbour Road serves authentic Cantonese cuisine in a setting that evokes a 1930s Taipan's mansion.
facts.excerpt: Capturing the old time splendor with elegance of a Taipan’s mansion in the 1930s, One Harbour Road serves authentic Cantonese cuisine

facts.text: Le Petit Chef's Dining Room offers an immersive 3D visual dining experience.
facts.excerpt: join us for an immersive and unforgettable 3D visual dining experience

facts.text: The Grill is set in the centre of a lush garden and offers alfresco dining.
facts.excerpt: Set in the centre of a lush garden, The Grill offers alfresco dining

facts.text: Grand Café is known for its Hainanese chicken rice.
facts.excerpt: as well as its famed Hainanese chicken rice

facts.text: The hotel holds a Crescent Rating of 5 for Muslim-friendly hospitality.
facts.excerpt: With the globally-recognized Crescent Rating of 5 signifying a certified standard level of Muslim-friendly hospitality

facts.text: The minimum age for check-in is 18.
facts.excerpt: The minimum age for check-in is 18 years old.

facts.text: Hong Kong International Airport is 35 kilometres from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Hong Kong International Airport (HKG)35 kilometers

facts.text: By Airport Express, guests take the train to Hong Kong Station and then a five-minute taxi ride to the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Take the train to Hong Kong Station, and take a five-minute taxi ride to the Grand Hyatt Hong Kong

facts.text: For sustainability, certain room amenities are discontinued or available only on request.

facts.text: The Premier Suite overlooks the outdoor swimming pool and landscaped gardens.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy the serenity of the 80-square-metre Premier Garden Suite which overlooks the outdoor swimming pool and landscaped gardens.

facts.text: Rooms have a glass-enclosed bathroom with a standalone tub.
facts.excerpt: The rooms appear bigger than they are thanks to a glass-enclosed bathroom, where you can enjoy the view from a standalone tub.

facts.excerpt: Combining the efficiency of a business hotel with the indulgences of a resort, the Grand Hyatt is a well-oiled machine in the Wan Chai district.
